mapper.select: SELECT bill_no, gen_org_code, COUNT(*) n, MIN(seq_dec) s, MAX(seq_dec) e FROM sn_item WHERE pi_no = #{pi} AND status = 'PENDING_ALLOC' GROUP BY bill_no, gen_org_code ORDER BY bill_no

SELECT factory_code, bill_no, COUNT(*) n, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT material_code) m FROM sn_item WHERE pi_no = #{pi} AND status = 'TO_PUSH' AND delivery_batch_no IS NULL AND suspend IS NULL
GROUP BY factory_code, bill_no ORDER BY bill_no
SELECT bill_no, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT material_code) m FROM sn_item WHERE pi_no = #{pi} AND status = 'PENDING_ALLOC' GROUP BY bill_no
mapper.update: UPDATE sn_line_count SET alloc_count = alloc_count + #{n}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE bill_no = #{bill} AND seq = #{seq}
mapper.sql:
SELECT pi_no, bill_no, SUM(qty) qty, SUM(pending) pending, SUM(to_push) to_push, SUM(suspended) suspended, MAX(handled_at) handled_at FROM sn_bill_stat WHERE 1=1
AND (pi_no LIKE #{q} OR bill_no LIKE #{q}) GROUP BY pi_no, bill_no
HAVING SUM(pending) > 0 OR SUM(to_push) > 0 HAVING NOT (SUM(pending) > 0 OR SUM(to_push) > 0)
mapper.select: ORDER BY handled_at DESC, bill_no DESC, pi_no LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT SUM(status = 'PENDING_ALLOC') pending, SUM(status = 'TO_PUSH' AND delivery_batch_no IS NULL AND suspend IS NULL) unbatched FROM sn_item WHERE status IN ('PENDING_ALLOC', 'TO_PUSH')

SELECT i.bill_no, i.bill_seq, IF(MAX(i.origin = 'IMPORT'), COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(i.material_code, '') ORDER BY i.material_code SEPARATOR ','), ''), MAX(i.material_code)) material_code, COUNT(*) n, SUM(i.status = 'PENDING_ALLOC') pending, SUM(i.status = 'TO_PUSH') to_push, SUM(i.status = 'TO_PUSH' AND d.id IS NOT NULL AND (d.result = 'FAILED' OR (d.result = 'UNCONFIRMED' AND d.push_state = 'EXHAUSTED'))) failed, MAX(CASE WHEN i.status = 'PENDING_ALLOC' THEN i.gen_org_code END) gen_org, MAX(i.factory_code) org, MIN(i.sn) a, MAX(i.sn) b, MAX(i.origin = 'IMPORT') imported, IF(MAX(i.origin = 'IMPORT'), COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(i.attach_no, '') ORDER BY i.attach_no SEPARATOR ','), ''), MAX(i.attach_no)) attach_no, MIN(CASE WHEN i.origin = 'GEN' THEN i.seq_dec END) s, MAX(CASE WHEN i.origin = 'GEN' THEN i.seq_dec END) e FROM sn_item i LEFT JOIN sn_delivery_batch d ON d.batch_no = i.delivery_batch_no WHERE i.pi_no = #{pi}
GROUP BY i.bill_no, i.bill_seq ORDER BY i.bill_no, i.bill_seq
SELECT bill_no, seq, qty, customer_pn FROM sn_prd_mo WHERE bill_no IN #{b}

SELECT DISTINCT factory_code FROM sn_item WHERE pi_no = #{pi} AND factory_code IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT DISTINCT factory_code FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE pi_no = #{pi} AND batch_type <> 'TRANSFER_OUT'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE factory_code = #{org} AND pi_no = #{pi})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_item WHERE factory_code = #{org} AND pi_no = #{pi} AND status = 'PUSHED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE factory_code = #{org} AND pi_no = #{pi} AND batch_type <> 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND result = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT batch_no, fail_reason, result, push_state FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE factory_code = #{org} AND pi_no = #{pi} AND batch_type <> 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND (result = 'FAILED' OR push_state IN ('WAIT_RETRY','EXHAUSTED') OR (push_state = 'WAIT_RECEIPT' AND receipt_timeouts > 0)) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT push_state FROM sn_delivery_batch WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo} AND result = 'UNCONFIRMED'
